verdict.rationale: SolidJS is a JavaScript UI framework (reactive state, JSX, SSR). It does not host or analyze a user's data inside a product, so in-product AI-generated insights from user data is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any such AI insight feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
